2608.03882.title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning
2608.03882.paper_summary: Geospatial reasoning, i.e., computing distances, containment, and other spatial relations over real-world entities, is central to navigation and logistics, yet large language models (LLMs) struggle with the required geometric and topological computation despite storing considerable geographic knowledge. Existing benchmarks localize these failures only partially: they are synthetic or smallscale, largely monolingual, and offer limited control over geographic coverage. We introduce MultiGlobeQA, a multilingual benchmark of 46,060 question-answer pairs spanning 14 spatial-function families and 15 answer formats, with execution-based ground truth over three knowledge graphs. It covers 201 countries and territories via income- and density-stratified sampling, with parallel questions in English and 16 additional high- and low-resource languages. Across parametric, reasoning, and agentic settings, LLMs collapse on tasks requiring grid indexing and shape computation, while topological relations and directions fare best. Retrieval and tool use yield considerable gains, yet performance plateaus below two thirds even when gold facts are supplied, indicating that computation, not access to knowledge, is the bottleneck. Models also underperform on low-income regions, a gap that gold facts widen rather than close.
2608.03882.paper_summary_zh: 地理空間推理，即計算距離、包含關係及其他空間關係，對於導航和物流至關重要，然而大型語言模型（LLMs）在所需的幾何和拓撲計算上卻表現不佳，儘管它們儲存了相當多的地理知識。現有的基準測試僅部分定位了這些失敗：它們是合成的或小規模的，主要是單語的，並且對地理覆蓋範圍的控制有限。我們推出了MultiGlobeQA，一個包含46,060對問題和答案的多語言基準，涵蓋14個空間功能類別和15種答案格式，並基於三個知識圖譜提供執行基礎的真相。它通過收入和密度分層抽樣涵蓋201個國家和地區，並提供英語及其他16種高資源和低資源語言的平行問題。在參數、推理和代理設定中，LLMs在需要網格索引和形狀計算的任務上表現不佳，而拓撲關係和方向的表現則最好。檢索和工具使用帶來了相當大的增益，但即使在提供金標事實的情況下，性能仍然停滯在三分之二以下，這表明計算而非知識的獲取是瓶頸。模型在低收入地區的表現也不佳，金標事實的存在反而擴大了這一差距，而不是縮小。
